claim: At Balaju Park (Siddhitol) Gorkha ground motions above ~1 s exceeded Nepal building-code spectra, indicating need for site-specific hazard analysis.
stance_target: Atlas scenarios need basin site amplification, not rock-only PGA
quoted_support: The resulting ground motions exceed the design levels from the Nepalese Building Codes, indicating the need for site-specific hazard analysis and for revision of the building code to address the effect of site amplification.
